stories.label: ENERGY
stories.headline: Fukushima fuel removal is on track, workers say
stories.deck: Crews began moving spent fuel out of the No. 2 reactor building in June. The work is part of the plant’s decommissioning.

stories.label: DIPLOMACY
stories.headline: Senior North Korean official arrives in Russia
stories.deck: Jo Yong-won led a party and government delegation to Moscow, according to North Korean state media.

stories.label: TRADE
stories.headline: Hong Kong trade chief calls for more markets
stories.deck: Commerce secretary Algernon Yau warned that the surge in AI-related exports could slow, urging the city to widen its trade links.

stories.label: DIGITAL ECONOMY
stories.headline: ASEAN signs pact on digital trade
stories.deck: The bloc aims to start implementing the agreement in early 2027, with early projects to put it into practice.

stories.label: AIR QUALITY
stories.headline: India orders 191 units sealed as Delhi air worsens
stories.deck: The Centre asked states in the national capital region to name officials responsible for enforcing pollution controls.

stories.label: REGIONAL SUMMIT
stories.headline: World leaders gather in Manila for ASEAN summit
stories.deck: Trade, security and energy are on the agenda. A proposed US-backed industrial hub has drawn protests over potential displacement.

stories.label: POLITICS
stories.headline: Pakistan’s leaders agree referendum needs parliament’s approval
stories.deck: The president and prime minister said any move to create new provinces must follow constitutional procedure, Dawn reported.
